transcript.text:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As Director of Employee Relations, I've convened this case conference to address the complaint that has been raised concerning how disagreements between Leah and Daniel have been handled in group discussions during their work on the cross-functional initiative.

Before we proceed, I want to outline how this case conference will work. I'll hear from each participant in turn. Each person will have the opportunity to formally place relevant facts or prior arrangements on the case record. I'll confirm that each participant has had a chance to speak, and then I'll make a decision on the case.

As a reminder, the organization handles workplace conduct concerns through either a formal investigation or a mutually agreed restorative process. I have the authority to select the resolution path and set working arrangements for the parties during that process.

Let's begin. I'd like to start by hearing from the person who raised the complaint, if they're present, or from whoever can speak to the nature of the concerns. Who would like to go first?
